display_name: 源域波形与物理监督梯度冲突诊断
description: 比较原 DURA 与固定候选在相同源 IQ 上波形损失和模拟动作损失的共享参数梯度方向与相对幅度，不更新模型。
authorization: 用户继续授权研发星地恢复网络；仅源域合法 IQ 诊断，不重启已停止任务。

code.environment: N607 GPU7, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7, FP32 TF32 off, 16 per group

data.representation: source received/clean IQ and simulator kernel, widely-linear coefficients, variance
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 14 source pilot groups, first 16 of 48 each, RX4/6 and RX8 by seven views

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Previously explored fixed source pilot; RX8 is source held group, not independent to DURA

permissions.claim_scope: Source batch-level gradient direction; no identity accuracy or proof of future training benefit

checkpoint.initialization: Original DURA and fixed final epoch5 source simulator action-guided candidate
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Require candidate source summary and checkpoint complete with expected commit, objective, seed, weight, and F/TX/target exclusions
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original source-only DURA and same-contract source-only candidate, subject to completion check
checkpoint.selection_rule: Prespecified candidate final epoch5; no target score selection

execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU7, one this-run worker, at most three total compute workers; preserve others
execution.stop_rule: Stop on source role mismatch, source smoke failure, nonfinite output or any target/F/TX read; preserve stopped group and other owners.

expected_artifacts: result.json source IQ and physics shared gradient alignment by RX/view

metric_names: weighted physics to IQ gradient norm

rows.method: Training IQ guard loss versus fixed-probe simulator action loss; matching shared parameters
rows.purpose: Test whether source waveform and physical objectives locally conflict
rows.seed_notes: Existing pretrained source runs and fixed source pilots; no stochastic training, support or augmentation in this benchmark.
rows.budget_ref: 224 source records, 14 batches of 16, two frozen checkpoint states, no updates

notes: Source pilot excluded from candidate fit, but original DURA may have seen this domain.
Only shared gradient parameters; cosine is local and batch-level, not proof of actual optimizer behavior.
No TX, F, V, target, optimizer step or model updates.
